corrections.why: The source places the lookout 17 miles NNW of Priest River; the record's point is about 55 km south-east of Priest River. The proposed point is computed from that bearing and distance using Wikipedia's Priest River coordinates (48.18222 N, 116.89 W). Check it against section 33, 59N-5W (Forest Lookouts).

notes_for_editor: Duplicate of us-id-big-meadows (researched 2026-10-10, same three sources, same facts); merge the two. The record's point is about 55 km south-east of Priest River, while the sources place the lookout 17 miles NNW; the proposed location is computed, so check it before applying. The three sources share one origin (Kresek and Kamstra data), so their agreement is not independent. No source describes the site today. Idaho Fire Lookouts reports no documented staffing history, so staffing is left out of the story. No photos added; the photo already on the record was not re-added. Story cites source 4 only for the correction, not in the footnotes.
